De plastic‑ en recyclingketen staat onde: The plastics and recycling chain is under pressure from growing waste streams and the need to use materials circularly. The Ministry of Economic Affairs has responded with the Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidy. According to the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), a total budget of €40 million is available. Up to €1.5 million can be awarded per research project and up to €7.5 million per showcase project. Applications must be submitted by a consortium, and the submission deadline is 6 October 2026 at 17:00. This subsidy provides financial support for both fundamental research and demonstration projects that contribute to a circular plastics economy.
